label: Aerosol optical depth at 550 nm (MODIS Aqua)
verdict: Aerosol optical depth at 550 nm (MODIS Aqua) (JJA, 2002-2025): the trend is +0.02 per decade, about +0.05 over the whole period. It is NOT statistically significant: p = 0.309 >= 0.05. That does not prove there is no trend; the change is not distinguishable from year-to-year variability with this many years. A longer record or a larger region can make a real trend significant. The last three years (2023-2025) depart from the trend by +0.12 (p = 0.0057).
